title: Typesafe Rust VCS Engine
description: Rework framework_vcs to be fully generic and typesafe (no Value/JsonReplaceOp). Backbone behind trait with URI resolver. Typed StudioOp and technology ops across all crates.
summary: Reworked framework_vcs into a fully generic typed engine (DocumentVcsStore<P, Op, A>, ApplyOp trait, no Value/JsonReplaceOp). Added Backbone trait with resolve_backbone(uri) for dev JSON, sqlite folder, and remote HTTP. Migrated semios_studio to StudioOp enum. Added typed ops and VCS stores to all technology Rust crates. Retired JsonReplaceOp from framework/core and migrated play controllers to recordProjectionChange with typed ops.
